teaser: What does it cost to hold a room together while also sensing something the room can't? Life path 11 and the ESFJ letters meet right there. Eleven carries a charge most people don't register and asks for it to be passed on in a form someone else can use; the ESFJ already knows how to turn feeling into casseroles, carpools, and seating charts. Here the gift wants shape faster than most people manage, and shape happens to be the one thing handled better than almost anything else.
excerpt: A phone left on silent through a late shift, checked twice in the break room anyway.
